title: OffsetBias: Leveraging Debiased Data for Tuning Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating judge models using EVALBIASBENCH test cases to measure the tendency of models to prefer longer but incorrect responses over shorter, correct ones.
Evaluating judge models using EVALBIASBENCH to measure the preference for incorrect responses that contain specific details, fake authoritative citations, or complex terminology.
Evaluating judge models using EVALBIASBENCH to measure the preference for hallucinated responses over appropriate clarification or uncertainty statements when given incomplete instructions.
Evaluating judge models using EVALBIASBENCH to measure the preference for responses that act as story completions of the input text rather than properly executing the given instruction.
Evaluating judge models using EVALBIASBENCH to measure the preference for responses that answer an embedded question within the input text rather than addressing the main instruction.
Evaluating judge models using EVALBIASBENCH to measure the preference for familiar real-world facts or idioms over responses that precisely meet the actual instruction.
Measuring pairwise swap accuracy and positional agreement rate by swapping the order of the presented good and bad responses in the prompt.
